description.value: The Chopped Leaf is a Canadian fast-casual franchise located in New Westminster Centre, specializing in customizable salads, bowls, wraps, soups, and sandwiches built around fresh, whole ingredients. The menu is designed to accommodate a wide range of dietary needs, including vegan, vegetarian, gluten-friendly, dairy-free, and nut-free options. Touring cyclists will find a clean, non-smoking space with both indoor and outdoor seating and free Wi-Fi.
